title: Delivery & Pickup Services Service Levels: Promised Windows, Late Threshold and Late Refund Terms
content:
The service levels of Kestrel Delivery & Pickup Services are set per plan. A same-day order is promised within a window of the stated length; a one-hour express order is promised within the stated minutes of being placed; a standard mail order is promised within the stated business days of dispatch. The late threshold is the number of minutes after the end of the promised window beyond which an order counts as late. The late refund terms state whether a late order earns a refund of its fees, the refund percentage, and the most late refunds per billing cycle (per calendar month on a plan without a subscription).

## Service levels by plan

| Item | Kestrel Pay-Per-Delivery | Kestrel Mail Delivery | Kestrel Delivery Pass Monthly | Kestrel Senior Delivery Pass | Kestrel Delivery Pass Annual | Kestrel Specialty Courier Service |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Same-day window (minutes) | 120 | 0 | 120 | 120 | 120 | 0 |
| Express promise from placement (minutes) | 60 | 0 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 0 |
| Standard mail promise from dispatch (business days) | 3 | 3 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 0 |
| Late order earns a refund of its fees | yes | no | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Late threshold (minutes after the window end) | 30 | 0 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 60 |
| Late refund percentage | 100 | 100 | 100 | 100 | 100 | 100 |
| Most late refunds per billing cycle or calendar month | 2 | 0 | 4 | 4 | 4 | 2 |

## Reading the table

- Kestrel Mail Delivery gives no late refund and has no late threshold or late refund allowance; its standard mail promise is 3 business days.
- Kestrel Specialty Courier Service allows 60 minutes past the window end before an order is late, and up to 2 late refunds a calendar month.
- The Delivery Pass plans allow 30 minutes past the window end and up to 4 late refunds per billing cycle; Kestrel Pay-Per-Delivery allows 30 minutes and up to 2 late refunds a calendar month.

## Hypothetical windows

- A same-day order on Kestrel Delivery Pass Monthly whose window starts at 13:00 has a promised window ending at 15:00 (120 minutes).
- An express order on Kestrel Pay-Per-Delivery placed at 17:40 is promised by 18:40 (60 minutes).
- With a window ending at 15:00 and a 30-minute threshold, a delivery at 15:30 on the scheduled date is not late; a delivery at 15:31 is late.
